actual_inputs: Only bounded existing native gameplay/UI endpoints; no source setters, callback dispatch, injected faults, native-PDS fabrication or process controls.
cases: fresh same-owner original accepted intermediate rich output prefix -> actual native PDS+inventory save -> exact Saved ACK
cached physical action exact retained primary and remaining extras -> action-scoped intermediate native owner save -> exact Saved ACK

Fresh intermediate prefix after externally performed cold-both reload: actual native owner PlayerId hydration and host station native load -> same original nonce -> actual restored native card reattachment -> remaining native outputs
required_observations: Distinct actual connected owner and authoritative server endpoints (--session and --server-session)
Immutable local original+host operation+nonce/source; current UI generation recorded separately
Positive intermediate prefix count, captured/sent native PDS digest/length, current original and Saved ACK
Cold-both requires saved prior original/topology plus replaced native processes and worlds at both endpoints
Historical debug evidence qualifies only while the actual current owner image equals the positively saved observed image
final_callback_role: role=final-callback with resumeKind=cold-both requires prior positive afterSaved, actual final native owner hydration and actual host final source. It asserts queueOnly actual card binding or queueTerminalSaved metadata-only completion with no callback replay; terminal observation does not require input or an extant consumed card.
saved_final_checkpoint: savedFinal=true requires expected.afterSaved=true, actual captured/sent final native PDS digest and length, current source, and full actual owner image equal to the positively saved observed frame. This covers ordinary full output and scrap callback where the never-sent insertion prefix is superseded by the final owner save.
deferred_native_role: role=deferred requires actual deferredNativeAdd=true on the retained original, actual input and saved prefix/final native PDS. Fresh and cached roles reject this identity. Cold deferred receipt authority remains a separate source leg; the existing cold-both gate does not admit this role.
limits: Actual partial inventory is prepared through real player inputs; driver does not inject a setter failure
Final host integration is a separate complementary production packet; cached/deferred cold remains outside this driver role
